The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **"The Girl You Lost"**, priced at **£12.29**.

I checked both pages of the category, which hold 32 books in total. Five of them are rated five stars: "A Time of Torment" (£48.35), "What Happened on Beale Street" (£25.37), "The Bachelor Girl's Guide to Murder" (£52.30), "The Silkworm" (£23.05) and "The Girl You Lost" (£12.29).

The tab I opened is still open on page 2 of the category.

I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin.org accepted it. The response page is still open in the tab I opened, `https://httpbin.org/post`.

The server echoed back these form values:
- **Name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and cheese (the "Extra Cheese" option)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** "Ring twice"

Another agent switched the shared browser's active tab partway through, so my first attempt to fill the form failed. Nothing was submitted by that attempt. I switched back to my own tab and filled and submitted the form there. I didn't touch any other tabs.

The order is complete. The confirmation page says "Thank you for your order!", and I left it open in my tab at https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html.

- **Login:** I logged in as standard_user.
- **Sort:** I sorted by price from low to high.
- **Cart:** I added the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light. The cart showed just those two items.
- **Checkout:** I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001. The order total was $43.18.

**Answer: Order complete — "Thank you for your order!" (total $43.18).**
